firm_data.firm_description: Outten & Golden LLP is an employment law firm representing individuals in discrimination, sexual harassment, and wage and hour matters. They advocate for justice and equity under the law, empowering employees and protecting their interests.
notable_facts: Largest employee-side firm in the United States

email.subject: AI for Outten & Golden LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Anna,

Outten & Golden's focus on discrimination and sexual harassment cases puts your team on the frontlines of complex, document-heavy litigation. These cases demand precision and speed, especially when competing for top talent and client trust.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how our ex-lawyer team is helping firms like yours compete with BigLaw on document review and case strategy.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
